Xie Yan: ‘…No, she won’t do.
#I treat you as my cousin, you want me to be the queen#
#Why is it so difficult to be a good cousin#

89118.synopsis:
The heir of a border lord sacrificed his life in battle, hoping to repay the lord’s kindness, but his efforts were in vain.
However, when he opened his eyes again…
“I’m… the First Prince?”
He had taken over the body of the notorious first prince.
The only problem… this guy was going to die soon.
associated_names: The Bastard First Prince Doesn’t Want to Die

89630.synopsis:
※ This work contains depictions of non-consensual acts and graphic cannibalism. Reader discretion is advised.
In a world reduced to ashes by nuclear war…
As extreme famine drives humanity to consume its own kind, monstrous beings called “Ghoul,” driven mad by their insatiable hunger for human flesh, begin to emerge.
Only ‘I,’ with the help of my brother, managed to survive without consuming human flesh.
“Even in death, I don’t want to be eaten.”
Determined to honor my dying brother’s wish, I risked my life to cremate his infected body.
But I failed.
Instead, I found myself captured by a group of strangers.
* * *
Long, slender fingers grasped my chin, lifting my head.
“Beautiful,” the man murmured.
He released my chin and yanked me forward.
As I stumbled after him, I saw the others loading my brother’s half-burned body into the back of a truck.
The moment I realized who they were, I tried to back away.
These were human hunters.
And I was about to become their prey.

90654.synopsis:
“Munchausen Syndrome by Proxy – The patient unconsciously fabricates illnesses in others to satisfy their desire to care for the sick.”
*
Everyone believed Shen Yu was a victim of Qi Fang’s power struggle. Only a few knew this marriage was orchestrated by the Second Young Master Qi after years of unrequited love – and two years into their marriage, he hadn’t even stepped foot in Shen Yu’s bedroom.
Teased by his friends, the Second Young Master Qi felt no shame. Instead, he began to brag:
“Simping? Nonexistent. Shen Yu’s been clinging to me these past two days. He not only helps me dress but also prepares loving lunches.”
Qi Fang opened the lunchbox in front of everyone and solemnly held up the loving note Shen Yu had written for him. He glimpsed the elegant handwriting:
[Qi Fang, 27 years old, middle-aged dementia, persistent episodes. If you notice any abnormalities in the patient, please call xxxxxx immediately. Thank you very much.] 
*
Shen Yu had recently contracted a strange illness, always believing Qi Fang was sick.
Flu, fractures, heart disease, middle-aged dementia… Hearing these nonexistent ailments, Qi Fang angrily slammed the table, collapsed on the spot, and immediately had an “episode.” He wouldn’t get up unless Shen Yu kissed him.
By playing the role of a qualified patient, Qi Fang enjoyed various peculiar “attentive” care. His life was prosperous. It was just a matter of time before he could step into Shen Yu’s bedroom door.
Until one day, Qi Fang discovered Shen Yu calmly logging into a mysterious website, earnestly asking on a medical website:
[Married for two years without having s*x, I suspect my partner has an incurable male problem. What should I do?]

90910.synopsis:
The first thing I saw when I opened my eyes was the man I had killed.
A hero who cannot be trusted has no real value.
What trust or glory could a ‘hero’ who was dragged onto the battlefield without even a single day of training possibly have?
A noblewoman who, by a stroke of luck, secured a high position through a divine oracle. No matter how much she struggled, her reputation never changed.
So it was only fitting that Mia Blanchard should not have come back to life.
“Are you regaining consciousness?”
In a time that had been rewound, the failed hero opens her eyes.
The voice belongs to an unexpected person—Etienne Rochefort, the man she had sent to his death with her own hands in her previous life.
If, perhaps, the goddess hadn’t desired this war.
Or, if she was dissatisfied with the path the hero had taken, the one Mia had chosen for him.
If that was the reason Mia was able to return to the past…
Was it a blessing or a curse?
The goddess did not give her an answer.
But this time, things could be different.
If this truly was an opportunity granted by the goddess, she wouldn’t let the same events repeat again.
Mia resolved to return the glory that had been rightfully his to the man who had lost everything because of her.
associated_names: The Wicked Woman Will Save You

92190.synopsis:
When the power went out, one of my roommates stole a kiss from me…
But I have no idea which one. So, I sent a group message to all of them.
“Your kissing skills are terrible.”
Just watch, I’m going to find out which one of you is the culprit!
associated_names: 停电时我被舍友偷亲了

92702.synopsis:
The b*tches who couldn’t catch me and were impatient are now obsessed with me after I retire. 
(Start of main story) The former members of the warrior party chased me all the way to my house.
associated_names: All the Warrior Party members are obsessed with me

93214.synopsis: When Bruno was eight years old, he got a turtle from a stall at a festival. That turtle, Ivy, continued to grow rapidly… and eventually became larger than a house. To prevent Ivy from being hunted, Bruno registered himself as a tamer and decided to start an adventurer’s life with Ivy. Wanting to sit on Bruno’s shoulder again like in the old days, Ivy gained the ability to adjust her size… and as it turns out, she was actually the strongest.

94494.synopsis:
The protagonist, Ryuhei Aizawa, wakes up one morning to find himself reincarnated into the world of Tenrai no Niji (The Rainbow of the Horizon), a romance-action RPG set in a modern dungeon. However, he’s not the protagonist in this world; instead, he’s a mob character, a year ahead of the protagonist in school.
Believing that a background character shouldn’t interfere with the storyline, Ryuhei decides to take a path that will keep him unnoticed. He chooses a path called the Martial God Route (nicknamed the virg*n Route), which leads to an ending where he avoids forming romantic ties with any of the heroines and lives quietly in the background.
But Ryuhei remains unaware of a few things. First, his obsessive training has earned him a school-wide reputation as the “Training Maniac.” And second, one of the senior heroines (who is now his classmate in this world) has heard of him and is trying to make contact…
associated_names: 先輩ヒロインの同級生に転生してしまった...

94750.synopsis:
The story is about the main character, a gloomy loner, who is spotted by the beautiful girls at the center of two major girl groups in his class and is left to do as they please.
[We’re breaking up.] 
On the first day of Golden Week, I, Tahara Hikaru, was told this by my childhood friend and girlfriend, Arimura Yui, as soon as I answered the phone.
One day, during my part-time job as a stuffed animal, I encountered a lost girl.
When I drop off the lost girl, it turns out to be the relative of Madonna Matsumura Hina, who is in the same class as me.
I, being a shy guy, decide to hide myself and get involved with her, but one thing leads to another and she finds out that I am Tahara Hikaru.
From there, her attitude suddenly changes.
associated_names: 迷子の妹を送り届けた着ぐるみの中の人が俺だと知ったクラスのマドンナがぐいぐいやって来る

95774.synopsis:
Ming Can, a top student at a prestigious university and currently a sophomore, unexpectedly encounters her biological son from more than a decade in the future on the street one day.
The boy, only five years old, is adorable and well-behaved. Ming Can, who naturally loves children, quickly accepts the reality of her future son traveling back to the present.
As for the child’s father, Ming Can refuses to involve herself with a stranger and decides to act as if he doesn’t exist.
A few months later, after much effort, she successfully enrolls her son in elementary school.
However, on his first math test, which has a perfect score of 100 points, her son shockingly scores a whopping 2 points.
The lifelong proud academic genius Ming Can has a mental breakdown. For the first time, she asks about the child’s father:
“Son, tell Mom honestly.”
“Could your biological father be mentally ret*rded?”
—
Her son mentions his father’s name, which sounds oddly familiar to Ming Can, though she can’t recall where she’s heard it before.
Until one day, Ming Can accompanies her friend to attend a lecture at A University’s auditorium.
Her friend introduces her to A University’s genius, who has earned so many scholarships that his hands cramped from receiving them, and says:
“Do you remember Senior Chi Xiao, the top science scorer from our previous class?”
Upon hearing the name, Ming Can’s heart skips a beat. She lifts her gaze and, sure enough, sees a handsome face that resembles her son by about thirty percent.
The rumored aloof genius senior takes the initiative to shake hands with her:
“Junior Ming Can, long time no see.”
Ming Can, unable to remember when she met him, quickly and dismissively touches his hand with some disdain.
“Are you really the top science scorer?”
“Are you sure you earned it yourself?”
The senior: …?
associated_names: My Child Could Never Score a 2

96030.synopsis:
The Marquis of Dongyang’s Heir, who had mourned his deceased wife for nine years, suddenly remarried. Looking at the new wife who had been brought home, the Madam of Dongyang nearly fainted from anger. And with the arrival of this little wife, many people’s peaceful dreams were also disturbed.
✿✿✿
Zhuang Li, an orphan with a mysterious past and a reputation for bringing misfortune, marries Zhou Jingyun, the widowed Marquis’s Heir, as a strategic move to escape the relentless investigations of the ruthless Censor, Zhang Ze. 
Jingyun seeks to protect Zhuang Li, whose true identity as Bai Li, the hidden daughter of a condemned official, could lead to her execution. 
While navigating the treacherous social landscape of the Great Zhou Dynasty’s capital, Zhuang Li’s unusual talents in medicine, incense-making, and dream-walking become both a source of intrigue and danger. 
As she grapples with her own troubled past and the complex dynamics of the Marquis household, Zhuang Li finds herself caught in a web of court intrigue, family secrets, and ghostly encounters, all while trying to maintain the facade of a dutiful wife and protect the precarious safety she has found with Jingyun. 
Meanwhile, Jingyun must balance his loyalty to his new wife with the political realities of a volatile court, where even the slightest misstep can have devastating consequences. 
As Zhang Ze closes in and rumors of Zhuang Li’s “jinx” spread, the couple must rely on their wits and a growing bond to survive the dangers that lurk both in the waking world and the realm of dreams.

98846.synopsis:
Wen Linyu was a timid and cowardly person. If someone slapped him, as long as they said “sorry,” he would reply “it’s okay.”
That was until he transmigrated into a stallion urban cultivation novel and was tasked with playing the villain who tormented the protagonist the most. If he could endure it for ten years, he could return home.
From then on, Wen Linyu was forced to play the role of a sinister and arrogant demon lord.
But he was cowardly.
So, facing a subordinate who betrayed him, he stammeringly reprimanded the other party for their wrongdoing. When asked to take action, he would cry in fear while gently slapping them.
The real Demon Lord, watching his subordinate enjoying the beating, couldn’t bear it any longer.
Thus, Wen Linyu gained a teacher who taught him how to be a villain step by step.
Under the teacher’s guidance, he became increasingly adept at playing the villain and experienced an unprecedented sense of unrestrained arrogance.
After ten years, Wen Linyu returned to his original world. Not long after his return, the person who had slapped him tried the same trick again.
As the other party’s hand was raised, Wen Linyu slammed them against the wall with a single palm.
Then, gripping the person’s hair, he emotionlessly recited the apology they had prepared in advance: “I’m sorry, I didn’t mean it. Can you forgive me?”
The person, covered in blood: “…” If I say it’s okay, will you let me go?
Wen Linyu’s parents recently discovered that their biological son, whom they had brought back from the countryside a few months prior, was very strange.
Their adopted son would complain of nosebleeds and headaches whenever he saw Wen Linyu and would take detours to avoid him.
Their younger daughter, who had called him unfashionable the night before, became infatuated with the accessories he casually made the next day.
The music teacher they specifically hired to cultivate his temperament praised his skills as surpassing her own and wanted to become his student.
Even more bizarrely, perfumers, swordsmen, and even metaphysics masters started inquiring about Wen Linyu.
Wen Linyu’s parents: ???
One night, a week after his return, Wen Linyu’s home was invaded. He prepared to use his finger as a sword, intending to leave the intruder with no chance of escape.
However, his fingertip was grasped, and his spiritual power instantly vanished.
“Who are you?” Wen Linyu asked coldly.
The intruder was the Demon Lord he had once impersonated. The man’s gaze lingered meaningfully on his lips and waist: “After being me for ten years, you think you can take that cultivation for free?”
associated_names: Having Played the Villain for Ten Years, I Came Back
我当了十年反派后穿回来了
我当了十年反派后穿回来了
我當了十年反派後穿回來了

101150.synopsis:
My first love is my childhood friend, Yamagami Ibuki. For her, I’ve devoted myself to being like a “stand-in wife,” taking care of everything she needs. Our relationship had remained unchanged since we were kids, but as we reached the age of working adults, things began to shift. 
“Ibuki, if you end up getting a lover, then say goodbye to me cooking your meals, cleaning your house, doing your laundry, reporting to your parents, or even filing your taxes!”
“W-What? Why?”
“Because… if someone’s coming over to your house at least three times a week and frequently staying over, that’d be unfair to your lover!!” 
Ibuki is a hopeless person who’s left all the housework to me. This can’t go on. For her own good, I need to distance myself. At least, that’s what I thought—until Ibuki started pulling tricks she’d never tried before to keep me around. 
“Alright, fine! Yukino, let’s get married!”
“W-Wha!?!”
associated_names: Kayoizuma Shitetara Kounin no Yome ni Natterashii
通い妻してたら公認の嫁になったらしい

101918.synopsis:
One day, Xu Jiu suddenly gained the ability to hear the thoughts of his rival, Chen Songyan. To his surprise, Chen Songyan never cursed him in his mind. Instead, he said things that Xu Jiu couldn’t understand.
While on a mission in the wilderness, Chen Songyan accidentally marked Xu Jiu.
The youthful feelings Chen Songyan had buried for a decade, once heavy as endless rain, finally cleared when Xu Jiu stepped into his life.

102686.synopsis:
At first, I thought it was just an ordinary fantasy game.
But as it turns out, it was actually a yuri academy story.
For everyone except me.
“Please, for the love of God, stop this nonsense.”
I didn’t raise my students just to be devoured by women in a woman’s body.

103198.synopsis:
Xu Yunqi attended a palace banquet and was mistakenly assigned by the drunken emperor to marry the most esteemed young master of the capital, Pei Muheng. Everyone said Xu Yunqi was lucky to marry such a golden husband; even the Xu family believed so.
Upon marriage, she found out that Pei Muheng had a childhood sweetheart from a well-matched family whom he had initially intended to marry.
On their wedding night, Pei Muheng was indifferent and distant, establishing three rules for their relationship. Xu Yunqi silently agreed to all of them. After marriage, they treated each other with respect, living a peaceful and uneventful life, with Xu Yunqi always staying within her bounds.
Pei Muheng, elegant and noble, was the most favored grandson of the emperor. He could have chosen any noble lady in the capital, but his grandfather’s random matchmaking assigned him to Xu Yunqi, a daughter of a common official family. Despite his displeasure, he had to accept the imperial decree. He spent most of the month in the palace, and his impression of his new wife was that she was gentle, quiet, and did not cling to him. After they consummated their marriage, he found her to be delicate and diligent in managing the household. Despite her humble origins, he thought he could live with her peacefully until old age. However, during a banquet, he unintentionally discovered that she had a “white moonlight” (someone she cherished deeply) in her heart.
Pei Muheng, who always prided himself on being decisive and emotionless, found himself tossing and turning at night, experiencing the pain of unrequited love for the first time.

103454.synopsis:
“The Enchanting Beauty”
That was the epithet bestowed upon a single model.
A prince from a certain nation had proposed to her. A petroleum tycoon from another had done the same. Whispers of such rumors spread, all because of her breathtaking beauty. Sakakibara Tsubame—an extraordinary young woman—had once been the childhood friend of Yukitsuki Shigure.
Back in elementary school, Tsubame moved away, and the two gradually lost touch. Shigure resigned himself to the thought that they would never meet again.
However, on the day of their high school entrance ceremony, Shigure encountered Tsubame once more. But the girl who stood before him was no longer the one he remembered—her expression was vacant, and a deep, unfathomable darkness had taken root in her eyes.
And so, as Tsubame, now broken, sought solace in him, Shigure made a silent vow—
To bring her happiness, no matter what.
associated_names: 笑うことが出来なくなった【傾国の美少女】を全力で幸せにしてみせます

104478.synopsis:
No matter how many dazzling adjectives you attach to him, at his core, he’s a thug.
The kind of man who would take a life if things didn’t go his way. Perhaps the only flaw in this otherwise perfect man is the world he stands in. That’s what makes him seem more dangerous, and that’s why he’s such a paradox—someone you can’t help but be drawn to.
I won’t deny that I was attracted to him, that my eyes were drawn to him. But that’s exactly why I wanted to distance myself.
—
“I have plans tomorrow.”
“…I know.”
“I’m meeting a man at a hotel.”
To be precise, it was a blind date at a hotel café.
—
“…But.”
“If I like him, I’ll book a room this time. I’m not going to reject him again.”
I wasn’t sure if I was saying this to Si-baek or making a promise to myself.
—
“Stop talking nonsense. If you’re just going to spout nonsense, go to sleep.”
If this were just a fleeting argument we had today, it wouldn’t feel so bittersweet. I have no idea when I’ll be able to put an end to this long, exhausting emotional journey. How much longer will it last? How many more wounds will I endure in the process? I’ll only know once I’ve lived through it.
Even if I know now, there’s nothing I can do about it.
It’s something I have to endure, even though I’m fully aware of it.
Nothing that has come into my hands has ever been easy. Love is no exception.
Damn love—no, unrequited love.

105502.synopsis:
Zhou Zhuofei was an ordinary office worker with an average family background and average grades. The greatest achievement she’d gotten in her life was receiving a job offer from a well-known corporation.
Everyone praised her for her good luck. Only she knew that it was guided by fate.
Four years ago, she caught a glimpse of her destiny and discovered that the world she lived in originated from a romance novel.
The novel’s female lead was her former neighbour. Like all female leads, she would experience dramatic ups and downs, meet a handsome male lead, and eventually live happily ever after with him.
As for Zhou Zhuofei, her sole purpose in the story was to recognise the newly appointed CEO’s wife as her old neighbour in front of the entire company.
That was right. She had exactly one line of dialogue in the entire novel.
Beyond that, her name appeared nowhere else in the entire novel.
Zhou Zhuofei had a great attitude. So what if she was just a background character? At least she had a decent job, with good benefits, and a cat.
As for how the male and female leads’ relationship progressed—what did that have to do with her?
But lately, she couldn’t shake the feeling that something in her life wasn’t right…
associated_names: Experiencing the Female Lead's Story as A Passerby

106270.synopsis:
The important thing was that no one died.
[Finally, it’s over. Congratulations.] 
“……”
Through a contract with Creon, the Time Demon, Rachel saved Tervan’s life that she had desperately wished for. 
But strangely, she didn’t feel particularly happy.
Twenty-seven times she regressed, enduring death’s pain each time.
Her emotions, worn and eroded from exhaustion.
She believed everyone except herself had returned to their places…
“I’m interested in you, my lady.”
“Excuse me, Your Highness, but I don’t think it’s me.”
“I’ve been too selfish all this time.”
“You don’t need to apologize, Tervan.”
“Rachel, may I escort you?”
“Edward?”
Attention that should have flowed elsewhere now poured toward Rachel.
Something had begun to change.

110110.synopsis:
Gu Zhizhuo felt that her previous life was cursed by the heavens, especially in the year she came of age, it was unbelievably unlucky.
Specifically, it manifested in:
1. She was born into a prestigious family, destined for wealth and nobility.
In the year she came of age, her family was confiscated and stripped of their titles, and her entire family perished.
2. She had been betrothed to the Crown Prince since childhood, destined to become the mother of the country.
In the year she came of age, her fiancé fell in love with someone else. To please his beloved, he destroyed her face and ruined her reputation.
3. She was exceptionally talented, skilled in both literature and martial arts.
In the year she came of age, however, she became known throughout the capital as a good-for-nothing, a spoiled and ignorant fool.
Meanwhile, her orphaned cousin Ji Nanke, who had been living in her home, was doing better and better.
She didn’t have to do anything—status, wealth, fame, even the title of Crown Princess all came to her on their own.
Everyone in the Da Qi Dynasty knew her as a girl blessed with good fortune.
It wasn’t until after her death that she finally understood that Ji Nanke’s good fortune had been stolen from her.
No wonder, in the year she came of age, their fates were completely reversed.
Good news: She was reborn.
Bad news: The moment she opened her eyes, her fiancé was conspiring with the imperial physician to drug her and ruin her face.
What they don’t know was that in her previous life, despite being plagued by bad luck, she painstakingly studied medicine, divination, and astrology, and she nearly became the State Preceptor.
*
In her previous life, Gu Zhizhuo barely survived exile and countless near-death experiences. It wasn’t until she met Xie Yingchen, whose own life also hung by a thread, that she finally had a chance to breathe.
Xie Yingchen was the late emperor’s eldest legitimate grandson—the former Crown Prince.
He taught her, cared for her, and paved a smooth road for her future.
Then, burdened by a lifetime of hatred and illness, he passed away.
Now, with everything reset, Xie Yingchen hasn’t yet fallen critically ill.
Gu Zhizhuo is determined to find him and cure him.

110622.synopsis:
Jiang Le had just gotten into university, at the peak of human intelligence, when he accidentally transmigrated into a pathetic cannon fodder character in a dog-blooded period novel—and was saddled with a useless “melon-eating” system.  
It was the resource-scarce 1970s. Staring at his malnourished, sallow-faced family members who were all at risk of kicking the bucket any second, Jiang Le felt utterly devastated.  
Until…  
When Auntie Zhang next door bullied them again, the useless system suddenly got excited: “Host, Auntie Zhang’s husband is infertile!”
Jiang Le glanced at Auntie Zhang’s five sons and three daughters: “!!!”
System: “Ding! If you expose the truth to Auntie Zhang’s husband, you’ll earn 100 melon coins!”
When the factory director ab*sed his power to steal Jiang Le’s cousin’s job for his niece, the system got hyped again: “Host, this factory director is colluding with the procurement officer for personal gain! Expose him and earn 500 melon coins!”
When a male educated youth who liked the female lead slandered Jiang Le, the system perked up once more: “Host…” 
Jiang Le looked at the system’s shop—where a tin of malted milk cost just five melon coins and a steamed white bun cost one—and suddenly felt like he’d struck gold.  
From then on, while the original novel’s male and female leads struggled just to survive, Jiang Le used his melon-earned White Rabbit candies, rare milk powder, and fashionable clothes (unavailable even in department stores) to nourish his once-gaunt family into glowing health.  
The original leads are too busy with their messy love games to notice. By the time they realize what’s happening, Jiang Le, the cannon fodder they once looked down on, has been admitted to Peking University.
But Jiang Le doesn’t have time for them. He’s focused on someone else—the only reason he kept reading the tr*sh novel that brought him here. That brilliant, tragic character… who didn’t survive the winter in the original plot.
Jiang Le clenches his fists: He won’t let it happen again!
Except… the more he protected this person, the stranger their gaze toward him became. What’s going on?!
associated_names: 年代文炮灰吃瓜爆改全家命运[穿书]
年代文炮灰吃瓜爆改全家命運[穿書]

111134.synopsis:
“Taste this, miss. It’s a magical potion that will surely help you achieve the love you desire.”
Evelyn, a country girl who envied her friend’s wedding, impulsively drank a love potion offered by a wandering old woman.
When she regained consciousness after fainting, she had transformed into a nymph of a small sapling that had sprouted where she had collapsed! The sapling would soon wither away, and when it does, she would die too. Such is the fate of a nymph.
Terrified, Evelyn is eventually sent along with the sapling to the elves, guardians of nature, in order to survive.
Because she is of human origin rather than a pure-blooded nymph, she is mistreated by the other elves. However, Cassis, their king, is exceptionally kind and treats the inexperienced Evelyn well. And then… He soon begins to permeate her life terrifyingly, starting with her bed and extending throughout her daily existence.

112926.synopsis:
As cannon fodder female supporting characters in the plot, they always act brainlessly and exit early. But one day, the tool-like supporting female character awakened, and the storyline began to completely collapse.
World One: [The Vicious Female Supporting Character in the 1980s] 
The childhood sweetheart fiancé was suddenly snatched away. Su Qin became the vicious and unreasonable female supporting character. The other party even said he only saw her as a younger sister and only understood what love was after meeting the female lead.
Su Qin cheerfully agreed to break off the engagement and wished them a long and lasting relationship, locked in for life. That tr*sh could go to whoever wanted him, she did not.
Anyway, the fiancé would end up as cannon fodder later. The real male lead was the future business tycoon.
What? Why does the tycoon want to marry her?!!!
World Two: [A female Teacher From The 1990s Who Despises The Poor and Loves The Rich] 
One moment, Fang Yuwei was a laid-off office worker drifting in Beijing, single and at an older age, with a bleak future.
When she opened her eyes, not only did she have a husband but also two kids. She was the male lead’s ex-wife who abandoned her husband and children to become a mistress, destined to give way to the female lead.
Fang Yuwei looked at the gentle and modest stay-at-home dad in front of her and the two adorable little kids longing for maternal love. The three of them shared the same face, all looking at her pitifully, afraid of being abandoned, carefully trying to please her.
So pitiful. No divorce. Absolutely no divorce!
By accident, she even became a nationally recognized outstanding teacher. With her husband on one side and kids on the other, she reached the peak of her life.
World Three: [The Pitiful Female Supporting Character from a Male-Favoring Family in the 2000s] 
A hardworking sales assistant at a hardware store × a silent and reserved small business owner
In her previous life, Ai Xiaoling was drained by her family and died young. In this life, she only wanted to cut ties with her family and earn some money.
As a supporting character, she knew well that she and the male lead were not on the same path. He was only helping her make money out of appreciation for her hard work. The female lead was his true match.
Later, the male lead actually wanted to date her? Fine. Dating was okay, but no marriage. He was just a qualified boyfriend.
Huh? Why does the male lead want to marry her?
Most importantly, she might be pregnant!!!
World Four: [The Spoiled and Willful Cannon Fodder Female Supporting Character] 
A naturally soft-voiced coquettish beauty × a cold and eccentric bookworm
As an infatuated female supporting character, Qiao Yiyi devoted her feelings to the wrong person. In this life, she switched targets.
What bad intentions could she possibly have? She just wanted to always protect her Song Jing.
The top student in the city already liked someone.
It was that coquettish girl!
World Five: [The Seductive Female Supporting Character in the Entertainment Industry] 
A glamorous actress supporting character × a shrewd and slick male agent supporting character
Shi He realized she was a forgotten supporting character in a sweet romance set in the entertainment industry. She was always causing drama and clinging to the male lead for popularity.
Anti-fans cursed her every day, just waiting for her career to collapse completely.
After waiting and waiting, Shi He ended up playing the female lead instead.
Ask her how? She was the agent’s “only treasure,” willful and proud, demanding to play the female lead in every project.
The agent shook his head while investing money, utterly helpless—she insisted on acting.
Fans shouted: Don’t love her too much!
World Six: [The Cold-Hearted and Ruthless Female Supporting Character] 
Zhen Qiao returned to her past life and saw her boyfriend selling braised pig trotters on the street, working hard to support her. His family was broken, his life in ruins, and in the end, she would scam him of his money and leave him in deep debt.
She no longer wanted to be evil. Thinking about the child in her belly and the loyal boyfriend wagging his tail like a big dog, she gritted her teeth and also started selling braised food.
A family must stay together!
